assessments.reasoning: The cryptsetup project’s GitLab COPYING at 3c3a8210e4927b5ce06481f91468c6ad9779b3aa has the claimed full-file digest. Bytes [18099,18801) contain the OpenSSL exception after the GPLv2 text and explicitly preserve GPL obligations for code other than OpenSSL.

The License Index’s SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7, bytes [640,783), admits documented additional permissions as exceptions. The OpenSSL linking and distribution permission satisfies that criterion while retaining its file-specific conditions.

The Index decision at 318db58e06be8f6682a6cb1520f0300df7ebd2c4, bytes [3029,3253), assigns dbe8f4af46b5480b88f015bb73d45d12, cryptsetup OpenSSL exception, edition cryptsetup-2-7-5, revision sha256:45670cce8b6a0ddd66c8016cd8ccef6cd71f35717cbacc7f1e895b3855207b33, kind exception and lifecycle active.

challenge.method: Tested a package-wide OpenSSL grant against the exception’s covered-code, modification and deletion provisions.
challenge.results: The text limits linking to portions of the program, refers to conditions in individual files and allows modifiers to omit the exception. It directs deletion of the package statement if the exception is deleted from every source file. A package-wide inference conflicts with those qualifications.

limitations: COPYING prints GPL version 2. An individual backend’s base-license declaration and coverage require that file’s own notice. No backend file was among the supplied dependencies.
The edition-to-digest association is explicit in the Index. The publisher capture identifies the immutable commit and file. A release tag was not separately inspected.
Active describes Index lookup. Publisher currency, SPDX status, work-specific grants, redistribution rights and release authorization have separate evidentiary requirements.
reasoning: The pinned cryptsetup COPYING grants permission to link portions of the program with OpenSSL and distribute the linked combinations under conditions described in each individual source file. Its digest matches the Index’s active exception row for cryptsetup 2.7.5.
